body.text: atha khalu punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ smṛtimān saṃprajānaṃstasmāt samādhervyudatiṣṭhat | vyutthāya caivaṃ ciantayāmāsa - na tadarddhiprātihāryasaṃdarśanena bhagavataḥ pūjā kṛtā bhavati, yathā ātmabhāvaparityāgeneti | atha khalu punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvastasyāṃ velāyāmagaruturuṣkakundurukarasaṃ bhakṣayati sma, campakatailaṃ ca pibati sma | tena khalu punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña paryāyeṇa tasya sarvasattvapriyadarśanasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya satatasamitaṃ gandhaṃ bhakṣayataścampakatailaṃ ca pibato dvādaśa varṣāṇyatikrāntānyabhūvan | atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvasteṣāṃ dvādaśānāṃ varṣāṇāmatyayena taṃ svamātmabhāvaṃ divyairvastraiḥ pariveṣṭaya gandhatailaplutaṃ kṛtvā svakamadhiṣṭhānamakarot | svakamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kṛtvā svaṃ kāyaṃ prajvālayāmāsa tathāgatasya pūjākarmaṇe, asya ca saddharmapuṇḍarīkasya dharmaparyāyasya pūjārtham | atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña tasya sarvasattvapriyadarśanasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya tābhiḥ kāyapradīpaprabhājvālābhiraśītigaṅgānadīvālikāsamā lokadhātavaḥ sphuṭā abhuvan | tāsu ca lokadhātuṣu aśītigaṅgānadīvālikāsamā eva buddhā bhagavantaste sarve sādhukāraṃ dadanti sma - sādhu sādhu kulaputra, sādhu khalu punastvaṃ kulaputra, ayaṃ sa bhūto bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ vīryārambhaḥ | iyaṃ sā bhūtā tathāgatapūjā dharmapūjā | na tathā puṣpadhūpagandhamālyavilepanacūrṇacīvaracchatradhvajapatākāpūjā, nāpyāmiṣapūjā nāpyuragasāracandanapūjā | iyaṃ tatkulaputra agrapradānam | na tathā rājyaparityāgadānaṃ na priyaputrabhāryāparityāgadānam | iyaṃ punaḥ kulaputra viśiṣṭā agrā varā pravarā praṇītā dharmapūjā, yo 'yamātmabhāvaparityāgaḥ | atha khalu punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña te buddhā bhagavanta imāṃ vācaṃ bhāṣitvā tūṣṇīmabhūvan ||
body.translated_text: Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, mindful and clearly comprehending, arose from that <s>samādhi</s>. Having arisen, he thought thus: 'Worship performed for the Blessed One through a display of supernatural power is not equal to worship through the sacrifice of one's own body.' Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, at that time, consumed agaru, turpentine, frankincense, and resin, and drank campaka oil. By this method, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, for the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, constantly consuming fragrant substances and drinking campaka oil, twelve years passed. Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, at the end of those twelve years, wrapped his own body in divine cloths, anointed it with fragrant oil, and made his own resolution. Having made his resolution, he set his own body ablaze as a worship-offering to the <s>Tathāgata</s> and for the worship of this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Dharmaparyāya</s>. Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, by the flames and radiance of the body-lamp of the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, eighty <s>Gaṅgā</s>-river-sand-numbered world-systems were illuminated. And in those world-systems, eighty <s>Gaṅgā</s>-river-sand-numbered <s>Buddhas</s>, Blessed Ones, all gave their approval: 'Excellent, excellent, son of good family! Excellent indeed, son of good family! This is the true effort of vigor of <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas</s>. This is the true worship of the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the true worship of the <s>Dharma</s>. It is not like worship with flowers, incense, perfumes, garlands, ointments, powders, robes, parasols, banners, and flags, nor like material worship, nor like worship with uragasāra sandalwood. This, son of good family, is the supreme gift-giving. Not like the gift of renouncing a kingdom, nor like the gift of renouncing beloved sons and wife. This, son of good family, is the most distinguished, the supreme, the finest, the highest, the most excellent worship of the <s>Dharma</s> — the sacrifice of one's own body.' Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, having spoken these words, those <s>Buddhas</s>, Blessed Ones, fell silent.

body.text: tasya khalu punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sarvasattvapriyadarśanātmabhāvasya dīpyato dvādaśa varṣaśatānyatikrāntānyabhūvan, na ca praśamaṃ gacchati sma | sa paścāddvādaśānāṃ varṣaśatānāmatyayāt praśānto 'bhūt | sa khalu punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattva evaṃrūpāṃ tathāgatapūjāṃ ca dharmapūjāṃ ca kṛtvā tataścyutastasyaiva bhagavataścandrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśriyastathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya pravacane rājño vimaladattasya gṛhe
body.translated_text: The body of that <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, burned for twelve hundred years without being extinguished. Only after the passing of those twelve hundred years did it become extinguished. That <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, having performed such worship of the <s>Tathāgata</s> and the <s>Dharma</s>, passing away from there, was reborn in the dispensation of that same Blessed One <s>Candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrī</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, in the house of King <s>Vimaladatta</s>,

body.text: upapanna aupapādikaḥ | utsaṅge paryaṅkeṇa prādurbhūto 'bhūt | samanantaropapannaśca khalu punaḥ sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvastasyāṃ velāyāṃ svamātāpitarau gāthayādhyabhāṣata -
body.translated_text: by spontaneous birth. He appeared seated cross-legged on his [father's] lap. And immediately upon being reborn, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, at that time, addressed his mother and father with a verse:

children.text: ayaṃ mamā caṃkramu rājaśreṣṭha yasmin mayā sthitva samādhi labdhaḥ /
children.translated_text: This is my walking-meditation ground, O best of kings, where, having stood, I obtained <s>samādhi</s>;

children.text: vīryaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ārabhitaṃ mahāvrataṃ parityajitvā priyamātmabhāvam // Saddhp_22.1 //
children.translated_text: with firm vigor I undertook the great vow, having sacrificed my beloved body. || <s>Saddhp</s> 22.1 ||

body.text: atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattva imāṃ gāthāṃ bhāṣitvā svamātāpitarāvetadavocat - adyāpyamba tāta sa bhagavāṃścandrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrīstathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddha etarhi tiṣṭhati dhriyate yāpayati dharmaṃ deśayati, yasya mayā bhagavataścandrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśriyastathāgatasya pūjāṃ kṛtvā sarvarutakauśalyadhāraṇī pratilabdhā, ayaṃ ca saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyo 'śītibhirgāthākoṭīnayutaśatasahasraiḥ kaṅkaraiśca vivaraiśca akṣobhyaiśca tasya bhagavato 'ntikācchruto 'bhūt | sādhu amba tāta gamiṣyāmyahaṃ tasya bhagavato 'ntikam, tasmiṃśca gatvā bhūyastasya bhagavataḥ pūjāṃ kariṣyāmīti | atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvastasyāṃ velāyāṃ saptatālamātraṃ vaihāyasamabhyudgamya saptaratnamaye kūṭāgāre paryaṅkamābhujya tasya bhagavataḥ sakāśamupasaṃkrāntaḥ | upasaṃkramya tasya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya taṃ bhagavantaṃ saptakṛtvaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya yena sa bhagavāṃstenāñjaliṃ praṇāmya taṃ bhagavantaṃ namaskṛtvā anayā gāthāyābhiṣṭauti sma -
body.translated_text: Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s> (Pleasing to All Beings), having spoken this verse, said this to his parents: 'Even now, mother, father, that Blessed One <s>Candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrī</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, still dwells, sustains, continues, and teaches the <s>Dharma</s> — he from whom, having worshipped the Blessed One <s>Candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrī</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, I obtained the <s>Sarvarutakauśalyadhāraṇī</s> (Dhāraṇī of Skill in All Sounds), and from whom this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>dharmaparyāya</s> (discourse) was heard in eighty <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundreds of thousands of verses, with <s>kaṅkaras</s>, <s>vivaras</s>, and <s>akṣobhyas</s>. It would be good, mother, father, if I go to that Blessed One, and having gone, will further perform worship to that Blessed One.' Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, at that time, rose up into the sky to a height of seven palm-trees, and seated cross-legged in a seven-jeweled tower-chamber, approached that Blessed One. Having approached, he bowed his head at the feet of that Blessed One, circumambulated that Blessed One seven times, and with joined palms facing that Blessed One, saluted him and praised him with this verse —

children.text: suvimalavadanā narendra dhīrā tava prabha rājatiyaṃ daśaddiśāsu /
children.translated_text: O Lord of Men, of supremely pure countenance, wise one, your radiance shines forth in the ten directions;

children.text: tubhya sugata kṛtva agrapūjāṃ ahamiha āgatu nātha darśanāya // Saddhp_22.2 //
children.translated_text: having made the foremost worship to you, O <s>Sugata</s>, I have come here, O Protector, for your sight! || <s>Saddhp</s> 22.2 ||

body.text: atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvastasyāṃ velāyāmimāṃ gāthāṃ bhāṣitvā taṃ bhagavantaṃ candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśriyaṃ saṃkusumitābhijña sa bhagavāṃścandrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrīstathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhastaṃ sarvasattvapriyadarśanaṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvametadavocat - parinirvāṇakālasamayo me kulaputra anuprāptaḥ, kṣayāntakālo me kulaputra anuprāptaḥ | tadgaccha tvaṃ kulaputra, mama mañcaṃ prajñapayasva, parinirvāyiṣyāmīti ||
body.translated_text: Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, at that time, having spoken this verse, said to that Blessed One <s>Candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrī</s> — and that Blessed One <s>Candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrī</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, said this to the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>: 'The time of my <s>parinirvāṇa</s> has arrived, O son of good family; the time of my end and dissolution has arrived. Go, son of good family, prepare my couch; I shall pass into <s>parinirvāṇa</s>.'

body.text: atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa bhagavāṃścandrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrīstathāgatastaṃ sarvasattvapriyadarśanaṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvametadavocat - idaṃ ca te kulaputra śāsanamanuparindāmi,
body.translated_text: Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, that Blessed One <s>Candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrī</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, said this to the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>: 'I entrust this teaching to you, O son of good family,

body.text: imāṃśca bodhisattvān mahāsattvān, imāṃśca mahāśrāvakān, imāṃ ca buddhabodhim, imāṃ ca lokadhātum, imāni ca ratnavyomakāni, imāni ca ratnavṛkṣāṇi, imāṃśca devaputrān, mamopasthāyakānanuparindāmi | parinirvṛtasya ca me kulaputra ye dhātavastānanuparindāmi | ātmanā ca tvayā kulaputra mama dhātūnāṃ vipulā pūjā kartavyā | vaistārikāśca te dhātavaḥ kartavyāḥ | stūpānāṃ ca bahūni sahasrāṇi kartavyāni | atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa bhagavāṃścandrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrīstathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhastaṃ sarvasattvapriyadarśanaṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvamevamanuśiṣya tasyāmeva rātryāṃ paścime yāme anupadhiśeṣe nirvāṇadhātau parinirvṛto 'bhūt ||
body.translated_text: and these <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas</s>, and these great <s>Śrāvakas</s>, and this <s>Buddha</s>-awakening, and this world-system, and these jeweled sky-vaults, and these jeweled trees, and these sons of the gods — my attendants — I entrust to you. And after my <s>parinirvāṇa</s>, O son of good family, I entrust to you my relics. You yourself must make extensive worship of my relics. And you must distribute those relics widely. And many thousands of <s>stūpas</s> must be built.' Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the Blessed One <s>Candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrī</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, having thus instructed the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, on that very night, in the last watch, passed into <s>parinirvāṇa</s> in the realm of <s>nirvāṇa</s> without remainder.

body.text: atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvastaṃ bhagavanta candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśriyaṃ tathāgataṃ parinirvṛtaṃ viditvā uragasāracandanacittāṃ kṛtvā taṃ tathāgatātmabhāvaṃ saṃprajvālayāmāsa | dagdhaṃ niśāntaṃ ca tathāgatātmabhāvaṃ viditvā tato dhātūn gṛhītvā rodati krandati paridevate sma | atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvo ruditvā kranditvā paridevitvā saptaratnamayāni caturaśītikumbhasahasrāṇi kārayitvā teṣu tāṃstathāgatadhātūn prakṣipya saptaratnamayāni caturaśītistūpasahasrāṇi pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsa, yāvad brahmalokamuccaistvena, chatrāvalīsamalaṃkṛtāni paṭṭaghaṇṭāsamīritāni ca | sa tān stūpān pratiṣṭhāpya evaṃ cintayāmāsa - kṛtā mayā tasya bhagavataścandrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśriyastathāgatasya dhātūnāṃ pūjā | ataśca bhūya uttari viśiṣṭatarāṃ tathāgatadhātūnāṃ pūjāṃ kariṣyāmīti | atha khalu punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvastaṃ sarvāvantaṃ bodhisattvagaṇaṃ tāṃśca mahāśrāvakāṃstāṃśca devanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragamanuṣyāmanuṣyagaṇānāmantrayāmāsa - sarve yūyaṃ kulaputrāḥ samanvāharadhvam | tasya bhagavato dhātūnāṃ pūjāṃ kariṣyāma iti | atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvastasyāṃ velāyāṃ teṣāṃ caturaśītīnāṃ tathāgatadhātustūpasahasrāṇāṃ purastācchatapuṇyavicitritaṃ svaṃ bāhumādīpayāmāsa | ādīpya ca dvāsaptativarṣasahasrāṇi teṣāṃ tathāgatadhātustūpānāṃ pūjāmakarot | pūjāṃ ca kurvatā tasyāḥ parṣado 'saṃkhyeyāni śrāvakakoṭīnayutaśatasahasrāṇi vinītāni | sarvaiśca tairbodhisattvaiḥ sarvarūpasaṃdarśanasamādhiḥ pratilabdho 'bhūt ||
body.translated_text: Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, having learned that the Blessed One <s>Candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrī</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, had passed into <s>parinirvāṇa</s>, prepared a funeral pyre of <s>uragasāra</s>-sandalwood and set ablaze the body of the <s>Tathāgata</s>. Having learned that the <s>Tathāgata</s>'s body was completely consumed by fire, he then collected the relics, and he wept, wailed, and lamented. Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, having wept, wailed, and lamented, had eighty-four thousand urns made of the seven jewels, placed those <s>Tathāgata</s>-relics in them, and erected eighty-four thousand <s>stūpas</s> made of the seven jewels, reaching up to the <s>Brahmaloka</s> in height, adorned with rows of parasols and hung with curtain-bells. Having erected those <s>stūpas</s>, he thought thus: 'I have performed worship to the relics of that Blessed One <s>Candrasūryavimalaprabhāsaśrī</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>. Yet beyond this, I shall perform an even more distinguished worship of the <s>Tathāgata</s>-relics.' Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s> addressed that entire assembly of <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, those great <s>Śrāvakas</s>, and those assemblies of gods, <s>nāgas</s>, <s>yakṣas</s>, <s>gandharvas</s>, <s>asuras</s>, <s>garuḍas</s>, <s>kinnaras</s>, <s>mahoragas</s>, humans, and non-humans: 'All of you, sons of good family, pay attention! We shall perform worship to the relics of that Blessed One.' Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, at that time, before those eighty-four thousand <s>Tathāgata</s>-relic-<s>stūpas</s>, set ablaze his own arm, adorned with a hundred merits. And having set it ablaze, he performed worship to those <s>Tathāgata</s>-relic-<s>stūpas</s> for seventy-two thousand years. And while performing that worship, he disciplined incalculable hundreds of thousands of <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of <s>Śrāvakas</s> in that assembly. And all those <s>Bodhisattvas</s> attained the <s>Sarvarūpasaṃdarśanasamādhi</s> (Samādhi of Displaying All Forms).

body.text: atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvāvān bodhisattvagaṇaḥ, te ca sarve mahāśrāvakāḥ, taṃ sarvasattvapriyadarśanaṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvamaṅgahīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā aśrumukhā rudantaḥ krandantaḥ paridevamānāḥ parasparametadūcuḥ - ayaṃ sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'smākamācāryo 'nuśāsakaḥ | so 'yaṃ sāṃpratamaṅgahīno bāhuhīnaḥ saṃvṛtta iti | atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sa sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvastān bodhisattvāṃstāṃśca mahāśrāvakāṃstāṃśca devaputrānāmantrayāmāsa - mā yūyaṃ kulaputrā māmaṅgahīnaṃ dṛṣṭvā rudata, mā
body.translated_text: Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, that entire assembly of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> and all those great <s>Śrāvakas</s>, seeing the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s> missing a limb, with tears in their eyes, weeping, wailing, and lamenting, said to one another: 'This <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s> is our teacher and instructor. And now he has become missing a limb, deprived of his arm!' Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s> addressed those <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, those great <s>Śrāvakas</s>, and those sons of the gods: 'Do not, sons of good family, weep seeing me deprived of a limb! Do not

body.text:
kradanta, mā paridevadhvam | eṣo 'haṃ kulaputrā ye keciddaśasu dikṣu anantāparyantāsu lokadhātuṣu buddhā bhagavantastiṣṭhanti dhriyante yāpayanti, tān sarvān buddhān bhagavataḥ sākṣiṇaḥ kṛtvā teṣāṃ purataḥ sattvādhiṣṭhānaṃ karomi, yena satyena satyavacanena svaṃ mama bāhuṃ tathāgatapūjākarmaṇe parityajya suvarṇavarṇo me kāyo bhaviṣyati | tena satyena satyavacanena ayaṃ mama bāhuryathāpaurāṇo bhavatu, iyaṃ ca mahāpṛthivī ṣaḍvikāraṃ prakampatu, antarīkṣagatāśca devaputrā mahāpuṣpavarṣaṃ pravarṣantu | atha khalu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña samanantarakṛte 'smin satyādhiṣṭhāne tena sarvasattvapriyadarśanena bodhisattvena mahāsattvena, atha khalviyaṃ trisāhasramahāsāhasrī lokadhātuḥ ṣaḍvikāraṃ prakampitā, uparyantarīkṣācca mahāpuṣpavarṣamabhipravarṣitam | tasya ca sarvasattvapriyadarśanasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya sa bāhuryathāpaurāṇaḥ saṃsthito 'bhūt, yaduta tasyaiva bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya jñānabalādhānena puṇyabalādhānena ca | syāt khalu punaste nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña kāṅkṣā vā vimatirvā vicikitsā vā - anyaḥ sa tena kālena tena samayena sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'bhūt? na khalu punaste nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña evaṃ draṣṭavyam | tatkasya hetoḥ? ayaṃ sa nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña bhaiṣajyarājo bodhisattvo mahāsattvastena kālena tena samayena sarvasattvapriyadarśano bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'bhūt | iyanti nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña bhaiṣajyarājo bodhisattvo mahāsattvo duṣkarakoṭīnayutaśatasahasrāṇi karoti,
ātmabhāvaparityāgāṃśca karoti | bahutaraṃ khalvapi sa nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña bodhisattvayānasaṃprasthitaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāmanuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhimākāṅkṣamāṇo yaḥ pādāṅguṣṭhaṃ tathāgatacaityeṣvādīpayet | ekāṃ hastāṅguliṃ pādāṅguliṃ vā ekāṅgaṃ vā bāhumādīpayet, bodhisattvayānasaṃprasthitaḥ sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā bahutaraṃ puṇyābhisaṃskāraṃ prasavati | na tveva rājyaparityāgānna priyaputraduhitṛbhāryāparityāgānna trisāhasramahāsāhasrīlokadhātoḥ savanasamudraparvatotsasarastaḍāgakūpārāmāyāḥ parityāgāt | yaśca khalu punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña bodhisattvayānasaṃprasthitaḥ kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāṃ trisāhasramahāsāhasrīṃ lokadhātuṃ saptaratnaparipūrṇāṃ kṛtvā sarvabuddhabodhisattvaśrāvakapratyekabuddhebhyo dānaṃ dadyāt, sa nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā tāvat puṇyaṃ prasavati, yāvat sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā yaḥ itaḥ saddharmapuṇḍarīkāddharmaparyāyādantaśaścatuṣpādikāmapi gāthāṃ dhārayet, imaṃ tasya bahutaraṃ puṇyābhisaṃskāraṃ vadāmi | na tvevaṃ imāṃ trisāhasramahāsāhasrīṃ lokadhātuṃ saptaratnaparipūrṇāṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ dadatastasya sarvabuddhabodhisattvaśrāvakapratyekabuddhebhyaḥ ||
body.translated_text: wail, do not lament! I, sons of good family, calling as witnesses all the <s>Buddhas</s>, the Blessed Ones, who dwell, sustain, and continue in the infinite, boundless world-systems of the ten directions, making a declaration of truth before them for the sake of beings — by this truth, by this true speech, may my arm which I sacrificed for the worship of the <s>Tathāgata</s> become again as it was before, and may this great earth quake with a sixfold trembling, and may the sons of the gods in the sky rain a great shower of flowers!' Then, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, immediately upon that act of truth being made by the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, this great trichiliocosm trembled with a sixfold quaking, and from the sky above a great shower of flowers rained down. And the arm of that <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s> was restored as before — by the power of knowledge and by the power of merit of that very <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s>. Perhaps, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, you might have doubt, uncertainty, or wavering — [thinking] 'Was it someone else who was the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s> at that time, on that occasion?' It should not be seen thus, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>. For what reason? It was this very <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyarāja</s> (Medicine King) who was the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s> at that time, on that occasion. So many hundreds of thousands of <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of difficult deeds, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, does the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyarāja</s> perform, and sacrifices of his own body does he make. Yet far greater, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, is [the merit of] that son of good family or daughter of good family who has set forth on the <s>Bodhisattva</s>-vehicle, aspiring to this supreme perfect awakening, who would light even a toe at <s>Tathāgata</s>-shrines. [Even] one who would light a single finger of the hand or foot, or a single limb, or an arm — that son of good family or daughter of good family who has set forth on the <s>Bodhisattva</s>-vehicle generates far greater merit than [one who gives] the renunciation of kingdoms, or the renunciation of beloved sons, daughters, or wives, or the renunciation of the great trichiliocosm with its forests, oceans, mountains, springs, ponds, wells, and gardens. And, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, even if a son of good family or daughter of good family who has set forth on the <s>Bodhisattva</s>-vehicle were to fill this great trichiliocosm with the seven jewels and give them as a gift to all <s>Buddhas</s>, <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, <s>Śrāvakas</s>, and <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s> — the merit that son of good family or daughter of good family would generate would be [no more than] what a son of good family or daughter of good family generates who upholds even a single four-line verse from this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>dharmaparyāya</s>. I declare the merit-formation of the latter to be far greater — not equal to filling the great trichiliocosm with the seven jewels and giving it to all <s>Buddhas</s>, <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, <s>Śrāvakas</s>, and <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s>.

body.text: tadyathāpi nāma nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sarveṣāmutsasarastaḍāgānāṃ mahāsamudro mūrdhaprāptaḥ, evameva nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sarveṣāṃ tathāgatabhāṣitānāṃ sūtrāntānāmayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyo mūrdhaprāptaḥ | tadyathāpi nāma nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sarveṣāṃ kālaparvatānāṃ cakravālānāṃ mahācakravālānāṃ ca sumeruḥ parvatarājo mūrdhaprāptaḥ, evameva nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña
body.translated_text: Just as, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the great ocean stands at the summit of all springs, ponds, and pools, in the same way, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>dharmaparyāya</s> stands at the summit of all <s>sūtras</s> spoken by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. Just as, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, <s>Sumeru</s>, the king of mountains, stands at the summit of all black mountains, <s>Cakravāla</s> ranges, and <s>Mahācakravāla</s> ranges, in the same way, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>,

body.text:
ayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyaḥ sarveṣāṃ tathāgatabhāṣitānāṃ sūtrāntānāṃ rājā mūrdhaprāptaḥ | tadyathāpi nāma nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sarveṣāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ candramāḥ prabhākaro 'graprāptaḥ, evameva nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sarveṣāṃ tathāgatabhāṣitānāṃ sūtrāntānāmayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyaścandrakoṭīnayutaśatasahasrātirekaprabhākaro 'graprāptaḥ | tadyathāpi nāma nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sūryamaṇḍalaṃ sarvaṃ tamondhakāraṃ vidhamati, evameva nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña ayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyaḥ sarvākuśalatamondhakāraṃ vidhamati | tadyathāpi nāma nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña trāyastriṃśānāṃ devānāṃ śakro devānāmindraḥ, evameva nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña ayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyaḥ sarveṣāṃ tathāgatabhāṣitānāṃ sūtrāntānāmindraḥ | tadyathāpi nāma nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña brahmā sahāṃpatiḥ sarveṣāṃ brahmakāyikānāṃ devānāṃ rājā brahmaloke pitṛkāryaṃ karoti, evameva nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña ayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyaḥ sarveṣāṃ sattvānāṃ śaikṣāśaikṣāṇāṃ ca sarvaśrāvakāṇāṃ pratyekabuddhānāṃ bodhisattvayānasaṃprasthitānāṃ ca pitṛkāryaṃ karoti | tadyathāpi nāma nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sarvabālapṛthagjanānatikrāntaḥ srotaāpannaḥ sakṛdāgāmī anāgāmī arhan pratyekabuddhaśca, evameva nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña ayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyaḥ sarvāṃstathāgatabhāṣitān sūtrāntānatikramya abhyudgato mūrdhaprāpto veditavyaḥ | te 'pi nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sattvā
mūrdhaprāptā veditavyāḥ, ye khalvimaṃ sūtrarājaṃ dhārayiṣyanti | tadyathāpi nāma nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sarvaśrāvakapratyekabuddhānāṃ bodhisattvo 'gra ākhyāyate, evameva nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña ayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyaḥ sarveṣāṃ tathāgatabhāṣitānāṃ sutrāntānāmagra ākhyāyate | tadyathāpi nāma nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña sarveṣāṃ śrāvakapratyekabuddhabodhisattvānāṃ tathāgato dharmarājaḥ paṭṭabaddhaḥ, evameva nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña ayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyastathāgatabhūto bodhisattvayānasaṃprasthitānām | trātā khalvapi nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña ayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ sarvabhayebhyaḥ, vimocakaḥ sarvaduḥkhebhyaḥ | taḍāga iva tṛṣitānāmagniriva śītārtānāṃ cailamiva nagnānāṃ sārthavāha iva vaṇijānāṃ māteva putrāṇāṃ nauriva pāragāmināṃ vaidya iva āturāṇāṃ dīpa iva tamondhakārāvṛtānāṃ ratnamiva dhanārthināṃ cakravartīva sarvakoṭṭarājānāṃ samudra iva saritāmulkeva sarvatamondhakāravidhamanāya | evameva nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña ayaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyaḥ sarvaduḥkhapramocakaḥ sarvavyādhicchedakaḥ sarvasaṃsārabhayabandhanasaṃkaṭapramocakaḥ | yena cāyaṃ nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña saddharmapuṇḍarīko dharmaparyāyaḥ śruto bhaviṣyati, yaśca likhati, yaśca lekhayati, eṣāṃ nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña puṇyābhisaṃskārāṇāṃ bauddhena jñānena na śakyaṃ paryanto 'dhigantum, yāvantaṃ puṇyābhisaṃskāraṃ sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā prasaviṣyati | ya imaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ dhārayitvā vācayitvā vā deśayitvā vā śrutvā vā likhitvā
body.translated_text: this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse is the king of all <s>sūtras</s> spoken by <s>Tathāgatas</s>, having reached the crown. Just as, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, of all the constellations the moon is the foremost illuminator, having reached the summit — even so, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse, among all <s>sūtras</s> spoken by <s>Tathāgatas</s>, is the foremost illuminator, surpassing <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundred-thousands of moons, having reached the summit. Just as, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the orb of the sun dispels all darkness and gloom, even so, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse dispels all the darkness and gloom of unwholesomeness. Just as, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, <s>Śakra</s>, Lord of the gods, is the lord of the <s>Trāyastriṃśa</s> gods, even so, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse is the lord of all <s>sūtras</s> spoken by <s>Tathāgatas</s>. Just as, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, <s>Brahmā Sahāṃpati</s>, the king of all <s>Brahmakāyika</s> gods, performs the work of a father in the <s>Brahmaloka</s>, even so, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse performs the work of a father for all beings — for all <s>Śrāvakas</s>, trainers and those beyond training, for <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s>, and for those who have set forth on the <s>Bodhisattva</s>-vehicle. Just as, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the stream-enterer, the once-returner, the non-returner, the <s>Arhat</s>, and the <s>Pratyekabuddha</s> have transcended all ordinary foolish beings, even so, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse should be known as having transcended all <s>sūtras</s> spoken by <s>Tathāgatas</s>, having risen above them, having reached the crown. Those beings too, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, should be known as having reached the crown — those who retain this king of <s>sūtras</s>. Just as, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva</s> is declared foremost among all <s>Śrāvakas</s> and <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s>, even so, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse is declared foremost among all <s>sūtras</s> spoken by <s>Tathāgatas</s>. Just as, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the crowned <s>Dharma</s>-king, [rules] among all <s>Śrāvakas</s>, <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s>, and <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, even so, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse is the <s>Tathāgata</s> himself for those who have set forth on the <s>Bodhisattva</s>-vehicle. Indeed, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse is the savior of all beings from all fears, the liberator from all sufferings. It is like a pond for the thirsty, like fire for those suffering from cold, like a garment for the naked, like a caravan-leader for merchants, like a mother for her children, like a boat for those seeking the farther shore, like a physician for the sick, like a lamp for those wrapped in darkness and gloom, like a jewel for those desiring wealth, like a wheel-turning king for all petty kings, like an ocean for rivers, like a meteor for dispelling all darkness and gloom. Even so, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse is the liberator from all suffering, the cutter-off of all disease, the liberator from all the bonds and constrictions of fear in <s>saṃsāra</s>. By whom, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse shall be heard, and who writes it, and who causes it to be written — the limit of the merit-accumulations of those, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, cannot be reached even by <s>Buddha</s>-knowledge — so great is the merit-accumulation that son of good family or daughter of good family will produce. Whoever, having retained, recited, taught, heard, written,

body.text:
vā pustakagataṃ vā kṛtvā satkuryāt gurukuryānmānayet pūjayet puṣpadhūpagandhamālyavilepanacūrṇacīvaracchatradhvajapatākavaijayantībhirvādyavastrāñjalikarmabhirvā ghṛtapradīpairvā gandhatailapradīpairvācampakatailapradīpairvā sumanātailapradīpairvā pāṭalatailapradipairvā vārṣikatailapradīpairvā navamālikātailapradīpairvā bahuvidhābhiśca pūjābhiḥ satkāraṃ kuryād gurukāraṃ kuryāt mānanāṃ kuryāt pūjanāṃ kuryāt, bahu sa nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña bodhisattvayānasaṃprasthitaḥ
kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā puṇyaṃ prasaviṣyati ya imaṃ bhaiṣajyarājapūvayogaparivartaṃ dhārayiṣyati vācayiṣyati śroṣyati | sacet punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña mātṛgrāma imaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śrutvā udgahīṣyati dhārayiṣyati tasya sa eva paścimaḥ strībhāvo bhaviṣyati | yaḥ kaścinnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña imaṃ bhaiṣajyarājapūrvayogaparivartaṃ paścimāyāṃ pañcāśatyāṃ śrutvā mātṛgrāmaḥ pratipatsyate sa khalvataścyutaḥ sukhāvatyāṃ lokadhātāvupapatsyate yasyāṃ sa bhagavānamitāyustathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho bodhisattvagaṇaparivṛtastiṣṭhati dhriyate yāpayati | sa tasyāṃ padmagarbhe siṃhāsane niṣaṇṇa upapatsyate | na ca tasya rāgo vyābādhiṣyate, na dveṣo na moho na māno na mātsaryaṃ na krodho na vyāpādaḥ | sahopapannāśca pañcābhijñāḥ pratilapsyate | anutpattikadharmakṣāntiṃ ca pratilapsyate | anutpattikadharmakṣāntipratilabdhaḥ sa khalu punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña bodhisattvo mahāsattvo dvāsaptatigaṅgānadīvālikāsamāṃstathāgatān drakṣyati | tādṛśaṃ cāsya cakṣurindriyaṃ pariśuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati, yena cakṣurindriyeṇa pariśuddhena tān buddhān bhagavato drakṣyati | te cāsya buddhā bhagavantaḥ sādhukāramanupradāsyanti - sādhu sādhu kulaputra, yattvayā saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śrutvā tasya bhagavataḥ śākyamunestathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya pravacane uddiṣṭaṃ svādhyāyitaṃ bhāvitaṃ cintitaṃ manasi kṛtaṃ parasattvānāṃ ca saṃprakāśitam, ayaṃ te kulaputra puṇyābhisaṃskāro na śakyamagninā dagdhuṃ nodakena hartum | ayaṃ te kulaputra puṇyābhisaṃskāro na śakyaṃ buddhasahesreṇāpi nirdeṣṭum | vihatamārapratyarthikastvaṃ kulaputra uttīrṇabhayasaṃgrāmo marditaśatrukaṇṭakaḥ | buddhaśatasahasrādhiṣṭhito 'si | na tava kulaputra sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake saśramaṇabrāhmaṇikāyāṃ prajāyāṃ sadṛśo vidyate tathāgatamekaṃ vinirmucya | nānyaḥ kaścicchrāvako vā pratyekabuddho vā bodhisattvo vā yastvāṃ śaktaḥ puṇyena vā prajñayā vā samādhinā vā abhibhavitum | evaṃ jñānabalādhānaprāptaḥ sa nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña bodhisattvo bhaviṣyati ||
body.translated_text: or made into a manuscript this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse, would honor it, revere it, respect it, worship it with flowers, incense, perfumes, garlands, ointments, powders, garments, parasols, banners, flags, victory-standards, musical instruments, acts of homage, folded palms, or with ghee-lamps, or with perfumed-oil lamps, or with <s>campaka</s>-oil lamps, or with <s>sumanā</s>-oil lamps, or with <s>pāṭala</s>-oil lamps, or with <s>vārṣika</s>-oil lamps, or with <s>navamālikā</s>-oil lamps, and with various other forms of worship — that son of good family or daughter of good family who has set forth on the <s>Bodhisattva</s>-vehicle, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, will produce abundant merit — whoever retains, recites, or hears this chapter on the Former Deeds of <s>Bhaiṣajyarāja</s>. Moreover, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, if a woman, having heard this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse, takes it up and retains it — that shall be her last female existence. Whoever, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, whether a woman, in the final fifty [years of the Dharma], having heard this chapter on the Former Deeds of <s>Bhaiṣajyarāja</s>, shall practice accordingly — she, departing from here, shall be reborn in the world-system <s>Sukhāvatī</s> (Land of Bliss), where the Blessed One <s>Amitāyus</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, surrounded by an assembly of <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, abides, persists, and continues. She shall be reborn there, seated on a lion-throne in the calyx of a lotus. Neither desire, nor hatred, nor delusion, nor pride, nor envy, nor anger, nor hostility shall afflict her. She shall obtain the five superknowledges as soon as she is born. She shall obtain <s>anutpattikadharmakṣānti</s> (the acceptance that dharmas are unborn). Having obtained <s>anutpattikadharmakṣānti</s>, that <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s>, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, shall see <s>Tathāgatas</s> as numerous as the sands of seventy-two <s>Gaṅgā</s> rivers. And his eye-faculty shall become so purified that with that purified eye-faculty he shall see those <s>Buddhas</s>, Blessed Ones. And those <s>Buddhas</s>, Blessed Ones, shall give him their approval: 'Excellent, excellent, O son of good family, that having heard this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse in the teaching of the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, you have expounded it, studied it, cultivated it, reflected upon it, given it attention, and proclaimed it to other beings! This merit-accumulation of yours, O son of good family, cannot be burned by fire nor carried away by water. This merit-accumulation of yours, O son of good family, cannot be described even by a thousand <s>Buddhas</s>. You have vanquished <s>Māra</s>'s adversaries, O son of good family; you have crossed over the battlefield of fears; you have crushed the thorns of the enemy. You are sustained by a hundred-thousand <s>Buddhas</s>. There is no one equal to you, O son of good family, in the world with its gods, <s>Māras</s>, <s>Brahmās</s>, and the multitude of <s>śramaṇas</s> and <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, except the <s>Tathāgata</s> alone. There is no <s>Śrāvaka</s>, <s>Pratyekabuddha</s>, or <s>Bodhisattva</s> who is capable of surpassing you in merit, wisdom, or <s>samādhi</s>.' Such shall be the attainment of the power of knowledge-support of that <s>Bodhisattva</s>, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>.

body.text: yaḥ kaścinnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña imaṃ bhaiṣajyarājapūrvayogaparivartaṃ bhāṣyamāṇaṃ śrutvā sādhukāramanupradāsyati, tasyotpalagandho mukhādvāsyati, gātrebhyaścāsya candanagandho bhaviṣyati | ya iha dharmaparyāye sādhukāraṃ dāsyati, tasyema evaṃrūpā dṛṣṭadhārmikā guṇānuśaṃsā bhaviṣyanti,
body.translated_text: Whoever, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, upon hearing this chapter on the Former Deeds of <s>Bhaiṣajyarāja</s> being spoken, shall give his approval — from his mouth shall issue the fragrance of the <s>utpala</s> (blue lotus), and from his body shall emanate the fragrance of sandalwood. Whoever shall give his approval to this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse — these shall be his advantages and virtues visible in this very life,

body.text: ye mayaitarhi nirdiṣṭāḥ | tasmāttarhi nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña anuparindāmyahamimaṃ sarvasattvapriyadarśanasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya pūrvayogaparivartam, yathā paścime kāle paścime samaye paścimāyāṃ pañcāśatyāṃ vartamānāyāmasmin jambudvīpe pracaret, nāntardhānaṃ gacchet, na ca māraḥ pāpīyānavatāraṃ labhet, na mārakāyikā devatāḥ, na nāgā na yakṣā na gandharvā na kumbhāṇḍā avatāraṃ labheyuḥ | tasmāttarhi nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña adhitiṣṭhāmīmaṃ dharmaparyāyamasmin jambudvīpe | bhaiṣajyabhūto bhaviṣyati glānānāṃ sattvānāṃ vyādhispṛṣṭānām | imaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śrutvā vyādhiḥ kāye na kramiṣyati, na jarā nākālamṛtyuḥ | sacet punarnakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña yaḥ kaścid bodhisattvayānasaṃprasthitaḥ paśyedevaṃrūpaṃ sūtrāntadhārakaṃ bhikṣum, taṃ candanacūrṇairnīlotpalairabhyakiret, abhyavakīrya caivaṃ cittamutpādayitavyam - gamiṣyatyayaṃ kulaputro bodhimaṇḍam | grahīṣyatyayaṃ tṛṇāni | prajñapayiṣyatyayaṃ bodhimaṇḍe tṛṇasaṃstaram | kariṣyatyayaṃ mārayakṣaparājayam | prapūrayiṣyatyayaṃ dharmaśaṅkham | parāhaniṣyatyayaṃ dharmabherīm | uttariṣyatyayaṃ bhavasāgaram | evaṃ nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña tena bodhisattvayānasaṃprasthitena kulaputreṇa vā kuladuhitrā vā evaṃrūpaṃ sūtrāntadhārakaṃ bhikṣuṃ dṛṣṭvā evaṃ cittamutpādayitavyam - ityetādṛśāścāsya guṇānuśaṃsā bhaviṣyanti yādṛśāstathāgatena nirdiṣṭāḥ ||
body.translated_text: as I have now described. Therefore, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, I entrust to you this chapter on the Former Deeds of the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvasattvapriyadarśana</s>, so that in the final time, the final age, in the last fifty [years], it may be current in this <s>Jambudvīpa</s> and not disappear, and that <s>Māra</s>, the Evil One, shall not find an opening, nor the <s>Mārakāyika</s> deities, nor <s>nāgas</s>, nor <s>yakṣas</s>, nor <s>gandharvas</s>, nor <s>kumbhāṇḍas</s> shall find an opening. Therefore, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, I sustain this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse in this <s>Jambudvīpa</s>. It shall be a medicine for sick beings who are afflicted with disease. Having heard this <s>Dharma</s>-discourse, disease shall not advance upon the body, nor aging, nor untimely death. Moreover, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, whoever, a son of good family who has set forth on the <s>Bodhisattva</s>-vehicle, were to see a monk who is a holder of such a <s>sūtra</s>, he should shower him with sandalwood powder and blue lotuses. And having showered him, he should generate this thought: 'This son of good family will go to the seat of awakening. This one will take up grass. This one will prepare a grass-spread at the seat of awakening. This one will defeat <s>Māra</s>'s hosts. This one will fill the <s>Dharma</s>-conch. This one will strike the <s>Dharma</s>-drum. This one will cross the ocean of becoming.' Thus, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, should that son of good family or daughter of good family who has set forth on the <s>Bodhisattva</s>-vehicle, upon seeing a monk who is a holder of such a <s>sūtra</s>, generate such a thought. And these shall be his advantages and virtues, as described by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.

body.text: asmin khalu punarbhaiṣajyapūrvayogaparivarte nirdiśyamāne caturaśītīnāṃ bodhisattvasahasrāṇāṃ sarvarutakauśalyānugatāyā dhāraṇyāḥ pratilambho 'bhūt | sa ca bhagavān prabhūtaratnastathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ sādhukāramadāt - sādhu sādhu nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña, yatra hi nāma tvamevamacintyaguṇadharmastathāgatena nirdiṣṭaḥ, tvaṃ cācintyaguṇadharmasamanvāgataṃ tathāgataṃ paripṛcchasīti ||
body.translated_text: While this chapter on the Former Deeds of <s>Bhaiṣajyarāja</s> was being taught, eighty-four thousand <s>Bodhisattvas</s> obtained the <s>dhāraṇī</s> that follows the skill in all sounds. And that Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, gave his approval: 'Excellent, excellent, O <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>! Indeed, you have been described by the <s>Tathāgata</s> as endowed with inconceivable qualities and virtues, and you have asked the <s>Tathāgata</s> who is endowed with inconceivable qualities and virtues!'

body.text: iti śrīsaddharmapuṇḍarīke dharmaparyāye bhaiṣajyarājapūrvayogaparivarto nāma dvāviṃśatimaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Thus [ends] the twenty-second chapter, named 'The Chapter on the Former Deeds of <s>Bhaiṣajyarāja</s>' (<s>Bhaiṣajyarājapūrvayogaparivarta</s>), in the noble <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse.

body.text: Saddhp_23: gadgadasvaraparivartaḥ |
body.translated_text: Saddhp 23: The Chapter on <s>Gadgadasvara</s> (Wondrous Voice) (<s>Gadgadasvaraparivarta</s>).

body.text:
atha khalu bhagavān śākyamunistathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhastasyāṃ velāyāṃ mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇād bhrūvivarāntarādūrṇākośāt prabhāṃ pramumoca, yayā prabhayā pūrvasyāṃ diśi aṣṭādaśagaṅgānadīvālikāsamāni buddhakṣetrakoṭīnayutaśatasahasrāṇi ābhayā sphuṭānyabhūvan | tāni ca aṣṭādaśagaṅgānadīvālikāsamāni buddhakṣetrakoṭīnayutaśatasahasrāṇyatikramya vairocanaraśmipratimaṇḍitā nāma lokadhātuḥ, tatra kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijño nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhastiṣṭhati dhriyate yāpayati vipulenāyuṣpramāṇena | vipulena bodhisattvasaṃghena sārdhaṃ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛto dharmaṃ deśayati sma | atha khalu yā bhagavatā śākyamuninā tathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhenorṇākośāt prabhā pramuktāḥ, sā tasyāṃ velāyāṃ vairocanaraśmipratimaṇḍitāṃ lokadhātuṃ mahatyā ābhayā spharati sma | tasyāṃ khalu punarvairocanaraśmipratimaṇḍitāyāṃ lokadhātau gadgadasvaro nāma bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ prativasati sma avaropitakuśalamūlaḥ | dṛṣṭapūrvāśca tena bahūnāṃ tathāgatānāmarhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāmevaṃrūpā raśmyavabhāsāḥ | bahusamādhipratilabdhaśca sa gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ | tadyathā dhvajāgrakeyūrasamādhipratilabdhaḥ saddharmapuṇḍarīkasamādhipratilabdho vimaladattasamādhipratilabdho nakṣatrarājavikrīḍitasamādhipratilabdhaḥ anilambhasamādhipratilabdho jñānamudrāsamādhipratilabdhaḥ candrapradīpasamādhipratilabdhaḥ sarvarutakauśalyasamādhipratilabdhaḥ sarvapuṇyasamuccayasamādhipratilabdhaḥ prasādavatīsamādhipratilabdhaḥ ṛddhivikrīḍitasamādhipratilabdho jñānolkāsamādhipratilabdho vyūharājasamādhipratilabdho vimalaprabhāsasamādhipratilabdho vimalagarbhasamādhipratilabdho 'pkṛtsnasamādhipratilabdhaḥ sūryāvartasamādhipratilabdhaḥ | peyālaṃ yāvad gaṅgānadīvālikopamasamādhikoṭīnayutaśatasahasrapratilabdho gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ | tasya khalu punargadgadasvarasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya sā prabhā kāye nipatitābhūt | atha khalu gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattva utthāyāsanādekāṃsamuttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃstenāñjaliṃ praṇāmya taṃ
bhagavantaṃ kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijñaṃ tathāgatamarhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhametadavocat - gamiṣyāmyahaṃ bhagavaṃstāṃ sahāṃ lokadhātuṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ śākyamuniṃ tathāgatamarhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ darśanāya vandanāya paryupāsanāya, taṃ ca mañjuśriyaṃ kumārabhūtaṃ darśanāya, taṃ ca bhaiṣajyarājaṃ bodhisattvaṃ darśanāya, taṃ ca pradānaśūraṃ bodhisattvaṃ darśanāya, taṃ ca nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijñaṃ bodhisattvaṃ darśanāya, taṃ ca viśiṣṭacāritraṃ bodhisattvaṃ darśanāya, taṃ ca vyūharājaṃ bodhisattvaṃ darśanāya, taṃ ca bhaiṣajyarājasamudgataṃ bodhisattvaṃ darśanāya ||
body.translated_text: Then the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, at that moment, emitted a radiance from between his eyebrows, from the <s>ūrṇākośa</s> (curl of hair), the mark of a great man. By that radiance, eighteen <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundred-thousands of <s>buddhakṣetras</s>, as numerous as the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, in the eastern direction were pervaded with brilliance. Beyond those eighteen <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundred-thousands of <s>buddhakṣetras</s>, as numerous as the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, there was a world-system named <s>Vairocanaraśmipratimaṇḍitā</s> (Adorned with the Rays of Vairocana). There a <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One named <s>Kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s> (Superknowledge Blossoming like the King of Constellations with Lotus-petal Purity) abided, sustained, and endured, with an immeasurable lifespan. He was teaching the <s>Dharma</s>, surrounded and attended by a vast assembly of <s>Bodhisattvas</s>. Then the radiance that the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One emitted from his <s>ūrṇākośa</s>, at that moment pervaded the world-system <s>Vairocanaraśmipratimaṇḍitā</s> with great brilliance. In that world-system <s>Vairocanaraśmipratimaṇḍitā</s> there dwelt a <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> named <s>Gadgadasvara</s> (Wondrous Sound), one who had planted wholesome roots. He had previously seen such radiance-illuminations of many <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, Perfectly Awakened Ones. That <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> had attained many <s>samādhis</s> — namely, the <s>Dhvajāgrakeyūra</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Banner-Peak Armlet), the <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Lotus of the True Dharma), the <s>Vimaladatta</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Gift of Purity), the <s>Nakṣatrarājavikrīḍita</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Play of the Constellation King), the <s>Anilambha</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Without Support), the <s>Jñānamudrā</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Seal of Knowledge), the <s>Candrapradīpa</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Moon Lamp), the <s>Sarvarutakauśalya</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Skill in All Sounds), the <s>Sarvapuṇyasamuccaya</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Accumulation of All Merit), the <s>Prasādavatī</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Abounding in Serenity), the <s>Ṛddhivikrīḍita</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Play of Miraculous Power), the <s>Jñānolkā</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Torch of Knowledge), the <s>Vyūharāja</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (King of Arrays), the <s>Vimalaprabhāsa</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Radiance of Purity), the <s>Vimalagarbha</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Womb of Purity), the <s>Apkṛtsna</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Totality of Water), and the <s>Sūryāvarta</s>-<s>samādhi</s> (Solar Revolution) — and so on, up to <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundred-thousands of <s>samādhis</s> as numerous as the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> had been attained by the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>. That radiance fell upon the body of the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>. Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>, having risen from his seat, arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, placed his right knee on the ground, and with palms joined toward that Blessed One <s>Kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, said this: 'I shall go, Blessed One, to that <s>Sahā</s> world-system to see, salute, and attend upon that Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One; to see <s>Mañjuśrī</s> the Prince; to see the <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyarāja</s>; to see the <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Pradānaśūra</s>; to see the <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Nakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>; to see the <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Viśiṣṭacāritra</s>; to see the <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Vyūharāja</s>; and to see the <s>Bodhisattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyarājasamudgata</s>.'

body.text: atha khalu bhagavān kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijñastathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhastaṃ gadgadasvaraṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvametadavocat - na tvayā kulaputra tasyāṃ sahāyāṃ lokadhātau gatvā hīnasaṃjñotpādayitavyā | sā khalu punaḥ kulaputra lokadhāturutkūlanikūlā
body.translated_text: Then the Blessed One <s>Kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, said this to the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>: 'You must not, son of good family, having gone to that <s>Sahā</s> world-system, generate a perception of inferiority! For, son of good family, that world-system is uneven, rough,

body.text: mṛnmayī kālaparvatākīrṇā gūthoḍillaparipūrṇā | sa ca bhagavān śākyamunistathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho hrasvakāyaḥ, te ca bodhisattvā hrasvakāyāḥ | tava ca kulaputra dvācatvāriṃśadyojanaśatasahasrāṇyātmabhāvapratilābhaḥ | mama ca kulaputra aṣṭaṣaṣṭiyojanaśatasahasrāṇyātmabhāvapratilābhaḥ | tvaṃ ca kulaputra prāsādiko darśanīyo 'bhirūpaḥ, paramaśubhavarṇapuṣkaratayā samanvāgataḥ, puṇyaśatasahasrātirekalakṣmīkaḥ | tasmāttarhi kulaputra tāṃ sahāṃ lokadhātuṃ gatvā mā hīnasaṃjñāmutpādayiṣyasi tathāgate ca bodhisattveṣu ca tasmiṃśca buddhakṣetre ||
body.translated_text: made of earth, strewn with dark mountains, filled with filth and mire. That Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, is short of body, and those <s>Bodhisattvas</s> too are short of body. Your bodily measure, son of good family, is forty-two hundred-thousands of <s>yojanas</s>. My bodily measure, son of good family, is sixty-eight hundred-thousands of <s>yojanas</s>. You, son of good family, are handsome, beautiful, of excellent form, endowed with supreme beauty of complexion, distinguished by the splendor of a hundred-thousand merits. Therefore, son of good family, having gone to that <s>Sahā</s> world-system, do not generate a perception of inferiority — neither toward the <s>Tathāgata</s>, nor toward the <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, nor toward that <s>buddhakṣetra</s>.'

body.text: evamukte gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvastaṃ bhagavantaṃ kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijñaṃ tathāgatamarhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhametadavocat - tathāhaṃ bhagavan kariṣye, yathā tathāgata ājñāpayati | gamiṣyāmyahaṃ bhagavaṃstāṃ sahāṃ lokadhātuṃ tathāgatādhiṣṭhānena tathāgatabalādhānena tathāgatavikrīḍitena tathāgatavyūhena tathāgatābhyudgatajñānena | atha khalu gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvastasyāṃ velāyāmanuccalita eva tasmād buddhakṣetrādanutthitaścaiva tasmādāsanāt tathārūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpadyate sma, yasya samādheḥ samanantarasamāpannasya gadgadasvarasya bodhisattvasya atha tāvadeveha sahāyāṃ lokadhātau gṛdhrakūṭe parvate tasya tathāgatadharmāsanasya purastāccaturaśītipadmakoṭīnayutaśatasahasrāṇi prādurbhūtānyabhūvan suvarṇadaṇḍāni rupyapatrāṇi padmakiṃśukarvaṇāni saṃdṛśyante sma ||
body.translated_text: When this was said, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> said this to that Blessed One <s>Kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One: 'I shall do so, Blessed One, as the <s>Tathāgata</s> commands. I shall go, Blessed One, to that <s>Sahā</s> world-system, by the sustaining power of the <s>Tathāgata</s>, by the empowerment of the <s>Tathāgata</s>, by the play of the <s>Tathāgata</s>, by the array of the <s>Tathāgata</s>, by the exalted knowledge of the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' Then, at that moment, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>, without stirring from that <s>buddhakṣetra</s> and without rising from that seat, entered into a <s>samādhi</s> of such a kind that, immediately upon his entering that <s>samādhi</s>, here in this <s>Sahā</s> world-system, on <s>Gṛdhrakūṭa</s> (Vulture Peak) Mountain, before the <s>Dharma</s>-seat of the <s>Tathāgata</s>, eighty-four <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundred-thousands of lotuses appeared — with golden stalks, silver petals, and the color of <s>padma</s>-<s>kiṃśuka</s> (flame-of-the-forest lotus).

body.text: atha khalu mañjuśrīḥ kumārabhūtastaṃ padmavyūhaprādurbhāvaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavantaṃ śākyamuniṃ tathāgatamarhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhametadavocat - kasyedaṃ bhagavan pūrvanimittaṃ yenemāni caturaśītipadmakoṭīnayutaśatasahasrāṇi saṃdṛśyante sma suvarṇadaṇḍāni rūpyapatrāṇi padmakiṃśukavarṇāni? evamukte bhagavān mañjuśriyaṃ kumārabhūtametadavocat - eṣa mañjuśrīḥ pūrvasmāddigbhāgādvairocanaraśmipratimaṇḍitāyā lokadhātostasya bhagavataḥ kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijñasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya buddhakṣetrād gadgadasvaro bodhisatvo mahāsattvaścaturaśītibodhisattvakoṭīnayutaśatasahasraiḥ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛta imāṃ sahāṃ lokadhātumāgacchati mama darśanāya vandanāya paryupāsanāya, asya ca saddharmapuṇḍarīkasya dharmaparyāyasya śravaṇāya | atha khalu mañjuśrīḥ kumārabhūto bhagavantametadavocat - kastena bhagavan kulaputreṇa kuśalasaṃbhāraḥ kṛtaḥ, yena sa kuśalasaṃbhāreṇa kṛtenopacitena ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ pratilabdhaḥ? katamasmiṃśca bhagavan samādhau sa bodhisattvaścarati? taṃ vayaṃ bhagavan samādhiṃ śṛṇuyāma, tatra ya vayaṃ bhagavan samādhau carema | taṃ ca vayaṃ bhagavan bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvaṃ paśyema, kīdṛśastasya bodhisattvasya varṇaḥ, kīdṛg rūpam, kīdṛg liṅgam, kīdṛkū saṃsthānam, ko 'syācāra iti | tatsādhu bhagavan karotu tathāgatastathārūpaṃ nimittaṃ yena nimittena saṃcoditaḥ samānaḥ sa bodhisattvo mahāsattva imāṃ sahāṃ lokadhātumāgacchet ||
body.translated_text: Then <s>Mañjuśrī</s> the Prince, seeing that manifestation of a lotus-array, said this to the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One: 'What is this portent, Blessed One, by which these eighty-four <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundred-thousands of lotuses appear — with golden stalks, silver petals, and the color of <s>padma</s>-<s>kiṃśuka</s>?' When this was said, the Blessed One said this to <s>Mañjuśrī</s> the Prince: 'This, <s>Mañjuśrī</s>, is the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>, who is coming from the eastern direction, from the world-system <s>Vairocanaraśmipratimaṇḍitā</s>, from the <s>buddhakṣetra</s> of that Blessed One <s>Kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One — surrounded and attended by eighty-four <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundred-thousands of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> — to this <s>Sahā</s> world-system, to see me, to salute me, to attend upon me, and to hear this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s> <s>Dharma</s>-discourse.' Then <s>Mañjuśrī</s> the Prince said this to the Blessed One: 'What accumulation of merit, Blessed One, has that son of good family performed, by which accumulation of merit, accumulated and heaped up, this distinction has been attained? In which <s>samādhi</s>, Blessed One, does that <s>Bodhisattva</s> practice? We would hear about that <s>samādhi</s>, Blessed One, and we would practice in that <s>samādhi</s>, Blessed One. And we would see that <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s>, Blessed One — what is his color, what is his form, what is his mark, what is his build, what is his conduct? May the <s>Tathāgata</s> kindly create such a sign by which, being summoned, that <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> would come to this <s>Sahā</s> world-system.'

body.text: atha khalu bhagavān śākyamunistathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhastaṃ bhagavantaṃ prabhūtaratnaṃ tathāgatamarhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ parinirvṛtametadavocat - karotu bhagavāṃstathārūpaṃ nimittaṃ yena
body.translated_text: Then the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, said this to that Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, who had passed into <s>parinirvāṇa</s>: 'May the Blessed One create such a sign by which

body.text:
gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattva imāṃ sahāṃ lokadhātumāgacchet | atha khalu bhagavān prabhūtaratnastathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ parinirvṛtastasyāṃ velāyāṃ tathārūpaṃ nimittaṃ prāduścakāragadgadasvarasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya saṃcodanārtham - āgaccha kulaputra imāṃ sahāṃ lokadhātum | ayaṃ tu mañjuśrīḥ kumārabhūto darśanamabhinandati | atha khalu gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvastasya bhagavataḥ kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijñasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya pādau śirasābhivandya triḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sārdhaṃ taiścaturaśītibodhisattvakoṭīnayutaśatasahasraiḥ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛtastasyā vairocanaraśmipratimaṇḍitāyā lokadhātorantarhitaḥ imāṃ sahāṃ lokadhātumāgacchati sma, prakampadbhiḥ kṣetraiḥ, pravarṣadbhiḥ padmaiḥ, pravādyamānaistūryakoṭīnayutaśatasahasraiḥ, nīlotpalapadmanetreṇa vadanena, suvarṇavarṇena kāyena, puṇyaśatasahasrālaṃkṛtenātmabhāvena, śriyā jājvalyamānaḥ, tejasā dedīpyamānaḥ, lakṣaṇairvicitritagātro nārāyaṇasaṃhananakāyaḥ | saptaratnamayaṃ kūṭāgāramabhiruhya vaihāyase saptatālamātreṇa bodhisattvagaṇaparivṛtaḥ puraskṛta āgacchati sma | sa yeneyaṃ sahā lokadhātuḥ, yena ca gṛdhrakūṭaḥ parvatarājastenopasaṃkrāmat | upasaṃkramya tasmāt kūṭāgārādavatīrya śatasahasramūlyaṃ muktāhāraṃ gṛhītvā yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāmat | upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya saptakṛtvaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya taṃ muktāhāraṃ bhagavataḥ pūjākarmaṇe niryātayāmāsa | niryātya ca bhagavantametadavocat - kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijño bhagavāṃstathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho bhagavataḥ paripṛcchati alpābādhatām ālpataṅkatāṃ laghūtthānatāṃ yātrāṃ balaṃ sukhasaṃsparśavihāratām | evaṃ ca sa bhagavānavocat - kaccitte bhagavan kṣamaṇīyam, kaccid yāpanīyam, kacciddhātavaḥ pratikurvanti, kaccitte sattvāḥ svākārāḥ suvaineyāḥ sucikitsāḥ, kaccicchucikāyā
mā atīva rāgacaritāḥ, mā atīva dveṣacaritā mā atīva mohacaritā mā atīva bhagavan sattvā īrṣyālukā mā matsariṇo mā amātṛjñā mā apitṛjñā mā aśrāmaṇya mā abrāhmaṇyā mā mithyādṛṣṭyo mā adāntacittā mā aguptendriyāḥ | kaccitte bhagavan nihatamārapratyarthikā ete sattvāḥ | kaccid bhagavan prabhūtaratnastathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ parinirvṛtaḥ imāṃ sahāṃ lokadhātumāgato dharmaśravaṇāya saptaratnamaye stūpe madhyagataḥ | taṃ ca bhagavantaṃ tathāgatarmahantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ sa bhagavān paripṛcchati - kaccidbhagavaṃstasya bhagavataḥ prabhūtaratnasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya kṣamaṇīyam, kaccid yāpanīyam, kaccid bhagavan prabhūtaratnastathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhaściraṃ sthāsyati | vayamapi bhagavaṃstasya prabhūtaratnasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya dhātuvigrahaṃ paśyema | tatsādhu bhagavān darśayatu tathāgatastasya bhagavataḥ prabhūtaratnasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya dhātuvigrahamiti ||
body.translated_text: the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> would come to this <s>Sahā</s> world-system. Then the Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, who had passed into <s>parinirvāṇa</s>, at that time displayed such a sign for the purpose of urging the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>: 'Come, son of good family, to this <s>Sahā</s> world-system! This <s>Mañjuśrī</s> the Prince delights in seeing you.' Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>, having bowed his head at the feet of that Blessed One <s>Kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, and having circumambulated him three times, together with those eighty-four <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundreds of thousands of <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, surrounded and attended [by them], vanished from that <s>Vairocanaraśmipratimaṇḍitā</s> world-system and came to this <s>Sahā</s> world-system — with world-systems trembling, with lotuses raining down, with <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundreds of thousands of musical instruments sounding, with a face having eyes like blue lotuses, with a body of golden hue, with a bodily form adorned by hundreds of thousands of merits, blazing with splendor, radiant with glory, with limbs decorated by marks, with a body compact like <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>'s. Having mounted a tower-chamber made of the seven jewels, in the sky at the height of seven palm-trees, surrounded and attended by a company of <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, he came [to this world]. He approached this <s>Sahā</s> world-system, and approached the king of mountains, <s>Gṛdhrakūṭa</s>. Having approached, he descended from that tower-chamber, and taking a pearl necklace worth a hundred thousand [coins], he approached the Blessed One. Having approached, he bowed his head at the feet of the Blessed One, circumambulated him seven times, and offered that pearl necklace to the Blessed One as a worship-offering. Having offered it, he said to the Blessed One: 'The Blessed One <s>Kamaladalavimalanakṣatrarājasaṃkusumitābhijña</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, inquires about the Blessed One's health — whether he has few ailments, few afflictions, whether he rises easily, whether he fares well, whether he has strength, and whether he dwells in comfortable contact. And that Blessed One said thus: "Is it bearable, Blessed One? Is it endurable? Are the bodily humors in balance? Are your beings amenable, easy to tame, easy to treat? Are they of pure body? Not too much given to passion? Not too much given to hatred? Not too much given to delusion? O Blessed One, are the beings not envious, not miserly, not ungrateful to their mothers, not ungrateful to their fathers, not irreverent toward ascetics, not irreverent toward brahmins, not holding wrong views, not with untamed minds, not with unguarded faculties? Have these beings, O Blessed One, conquered <s>Māra</s> the adversary? Has the Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, who has passed into <s>parinirvāṇa</s>, come to this <s>Sahā</s> world-system to hear the <s>Dharma</s>, within the <s>stūpa</s> of the seven jewels?" And that Blessed One inquires about that Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One: "Is it bearable for that Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>? Is it endurable? Will the Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, remain for a long time? We too, Blessed One, wish to see the relic-body of that Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One. Please, may the Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, show us the relic-body of that Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One."'

body.text: atha khalu bhagavān śākyamunistathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhastaṃ bhagavantaṃ prabhūtaratnaṃ
body.translated_text: Then the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, said to that Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>,

body.text: tathāgatamarhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ parinirvṛtametadavocat - ayaṃ bhagavan gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavantaṃ prabhūtaratnaṃ tathāgatamarhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ parinirvṛtaṃ draṣṭukāmaḥ | atha khalu bhagavān prabhūtaratnastathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhastaṃ gadgadasvaraṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvametadavocat - sādhu sādhu kulaputra, yatra hi nāma tvaṃ bhagavantaṃ śākyamuniṃ tathāgatamarhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ draṣṭukāmo 'bhyāgataḥ, imaṃ ca saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāya śrāvaṇāya mañjuśriyaṃ ca kumārabhūtaṃ darśanāyeti ||
body.translated_text: <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, who had passed into <s>parinirvāṇa</s>: 'This, Blessed One, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>, wishes to see the Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, who has passed into <s>parinirvāṇa</s>.' Then the Blessed One <s>Prabhūtaratna</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, said to the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>: 'Excellent, excellent, son of good family! That you have come here, wishing to see the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, and to hear this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Dharmaparyāya</s>, and to see <s>Mañjuśrī</s> the Prince!'

body.text:
atha khalu padmaśrīrbodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavantametadavocat - kīdṛśaṃ bhagavan gadgadasvareṇa bodhisattvena mahāsattvena pūrvaṃ kuśalamūlamavaropitam, kasya vā tathāgatasyāntike? atha khalu bhagavān śākyamunistathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ padmaśriyaṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvametadavocat - bhūtapūrvaṃ kulaputra atīte 'dhvani asaṃkhyeye kalpe asaṃkhyeyatare vipule aprameye apramāṇe yadāsīt | tena kālena tena samayena meghadundubhisvararājo nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho loka udapādi vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavidanuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān sarvarūpasaṃdarśanāyāṃ lokadhātau priyadarśane kalpe | tasya khalu punaḥ kulaputra bhagavato meghadundubhisvararājasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya gadgadasvareṇa bodhisattvena mahāsattvena tūryaśatasahasrapravāditena dvādaśavarṣaśatasahasrāṇi pūjā kṛtābhūt | saptaratnamayānāṃ ca bhājanānāṃ caturaśītisahasrāṇi dattānyabhūvan | tatra kulaputra meghadundubhisvararājasya tathāgatasya pravacane gadgadasvareṇa bodhisattvena mahāsattvena iyamīdṛśī śrīḥ prāptā | syāt khalu punaste kulaputra kāṅkṣā vā vimatirvā vicikitsā vā - anyaḥ sa tena kālena tena samayena gadgadasvaro nāma bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'bhūt, yena sā tasya bhagavato meghadundubhisvararājasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya pūjā kṛtā, tāni caturaśītibhājanasahasrāṇi dattāni? na khalu punaste kulaputra evaṃ draṣṭavyam | tatkasya hetoḥ? ayameva sa kulaputra gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'bhūt, yena sā tasya bhagavato meghadundubhisvararājasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya pūjā kṛtā, tāni caturaśitibhājanasahasrāṇi dattāni | evaṃ bahubuddhaparyupāsitaḥ kulaputra gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ bahubuddhaśatasahasrāvaropitakuśalamūlaḥ kṛtabuddhaparikarmā | dṛṣṭapūrvāścānena gadgadasvareṇa bodhisattvena mahāsattvena gaṅgānadīvālikāsamā buddhā bhagavantaḥ | paśyasi tvaṃ padmaśrīretaṃ gadgadasvaraṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvam? padmaśrīrāha - paśyāmi bhagavan, paśyāmi sugata | bhagavānāha - eṣa khalu punaḥ padmaśrīrgadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bahubhī rūpairimaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ
deśayati sma | tadyathā - kvacid brahmarūpeṇa, kvacid rūdrarūpeṇa, kvacicchakrarūpeṇa, kvacidīśvararūpeṇa, kvacit senāpatirūpeṇa, kvacid vaiśravaṇarūpeṇa, kvaciccakravartirūpeṇa, kvacit koṭṭarājarūpeṇa, kvacicchreṣṭhirūpeṇa, kvacid gṛhapatirūpeṇa, kvacinnaigamarūpeṇa, kvacid brāhmaṇarūpeṇa imaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Padmaśrī</s> said to the Blessed One: 'What kind of root of merit was formerly planted by the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>, Blessed One? And in the presence of which <s>Tathāgata</s>?' Then the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, said to the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Padmaśrī</s>: 'In the past, son of good family, in a former age, in an incalculable <s>kalpa</s>, more incalculable still, vast and immeasurable — at that time, in that era, there arose in the world a <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One named <s>Meghadundubhisvararāja</s> (King of Thunder-Cloud Voice), endowed with knowledge and conduct, a <s>Sugata</s>, knower of the world, unsurpassed, tamer of men to be tamed, teacher of gods and humans, a <s>Buddha</s>, a Blessed One, in a world-system called <s>Sarvarūpasaṃdarśanā</s> (Vision-of-All-Forms), in a <s>kalpa</s> named <s>Priyadarśana</s> (Pleasant-to-See). In the dispensation of that Blessed One <s>Meghadundubhisvararāja</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> performed worship for twelve hundred thousand years with an ensemble of a hundred thousand instruments, and offered eighty-four thousand vessels made of the seven jewels. Through this, son of good family, in the dispensation of the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Meghadundubhisvararāja</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> attained such splendor. Do you, son of good family, perhaps have doubt, hesitation, or uncertainty — thinking that it was someone else who was the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> named <s>Gadgadasvara</s> at that time, at that occasion, who performed that worship to the Blessed One <s>Meghadundubhisvararāja</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, and offered those eighty-four thousand vessels? You should not see it thus, son of good family. For what reason? This very <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> was the one who performed that worship to the Blessed One <s>Meghadundubhisvararāja</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, and offered those eighty-four thousand vessels. Thus, son of good family, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> has attended many <s>Buddhas</s>, has planted roots of merit under many hundreds of thousands of <s>Buddhas</s>, and has prepared himself before <s>Buddhas</s>. The <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> has previously seen <s>Buddhas</s>, Blessed Ones, as numerous as the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>. Do you see this <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>, O <s>Padmaśrī</s>?' <s>Padmaśrī</s> said: 'I see him, Blessed One; I see him, <s>Sugata</s>.' The Blessed One said: 'This <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>, O <s>Padmaśrī</s>, teaches this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Dharmaparyāya</s> to beings in many forms. That is to say — sometimes in the form of <s>Brahmā</s>, sometimes in the form of <s>Rudra</s>, sometimes in the form of <s>Śakra</s>, sometimes in the form of <s>Īśvara</s>, sometimes in the form of a general, sometimes in the form of <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>, sometimes in the form of a <s>Cakravartin</s>, sometimes in the form of a minor king, sometimes in the form of a guild-master, sometimes in the form of a householder, sometimes in the form of a townsman, sometimes in the form of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> — he teaches this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka</s>

body.text:
dharmaparyāyaṃ deśayati sma | kvacid bhikṣurūpeṇa, kvacid bhikṣuṇīrūpeṇa, kvacidupāsakarūpeṇa, kvacidupāsikārūpeṇa kvacicchreṣṭhibhāryārūpeṇa, kvacid gṛhapatibhāryārūpeṇa, kvacinnaigamabhāryārūpeṇa, kvaciddārakarūpeṇa, kvaciddārikārūpeṇa, gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ imaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ sattvānāṃ deśayati sma | iyadbhiḥ kulaputra rūpasaṃdarśanairgadgadasvaro bodhisatvo mahāsattva imaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ sattvānāṃ deśayati sma | yāvat keṣāṃcid yakṣarūpeṇa gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattva imaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ sattvānāṃ deśayati sma | keṣāṃcit surarūpeṇa, keṣāṃcid garūḍarūpeṇa, keṣāṃcit kinnararūpeṇa, keṣāṃcinmahoragarūpeṇa gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattva imaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ sattvānāṃ deśayati sma | yāvannirayatiryagyoniyamalokākṣaṇopapannānāmapi sattvānāṃ gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattva imaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ deśayaṃstrātā bhavati | yāvadantaḥpuramadhyagatānāmapi sattvānāṃ gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ strīrūpamabhinirmāya ima saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ sattvānāṃ deśayati sma | asyāṃ sahāyāṃ lokadhātau sattvānāṃ dharmaṃ deśayati sma | trātā khalvapi padmaśrīrgadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sahāyāṃ lokadhātāvupapannānāṃ sattvānām | tasyāṃ ca sahāyāṃ lokadhātāveva sa gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattva iyadbhī rūpanimittairimaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ sattvānāṃ deśayati | na cāsya satpuruṣasya ṛddhihānirnāpi prajñāhāniḥ | iyadbhiḥ kulaputra jñānāvabhāsairgadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'syāṃ sahāyāṃ lokadhātau prajñāyate | anyeṣu ca gaṅgānadīvālikāsameṣu lokadhātuṣu bodhisattvavaineyānāṃ
sattvānāṃ bodhisattvarūpeṇa dharmaṃ deśayati | śrāvakavaineyānāṃ sattvānāṃ śrāvakarūpeṇa dharmaṃ deśayati | pratyekabuddhavaineyānāṃ sattvānāṃ pratyekabuddharūpeṇa dharmaṃ deśayati | tathāgatavaineyānāṃ sattvānāṃ tathāgatarūpeṇa dharmaṃ deśayati | yāvattathāgatadhātuvaineyānāṃ sattvānāṃ tathāgatadhātuṃ darśayati | yāvat parinirvāṇavaineyānāṃ sattvānāṃ parinirvṛtamātmānaṃ darśayati | evaṃ jñānabalādhānaprāptaḥ khalu punaḥ padmaśrīrgadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ ||
body.translated_text: <s>Dharmaparyāya</s>. Sometimes in the form of a monk, sometimes in the form of a nun, sometimes in the form of a male lay-follower, sometimes in the form of a female lay-follower, sometimes in the form of a guild-master's wife, sometimes in the form of a householder's wife, sometimes in the form of a townsman's wife, sometimes in the form of a boy, sometimes in the form of a girl — the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> teaches this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Dharmaparyāya</s> to beings. With so many forms and appearances, son of good family, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> teaches this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Dharmaparyāya</s> to beings. Even in the form of a <s>Yakṣa</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> teaches this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Dharmaparyāya</s> to some beings. To some in the form of a god, to some in the form of a <s>Garuḍa</s>, to some in the form of a <s>Kinnara</s>, to some in the form of a <s>Mahoraga</s> — the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> teaches this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Dharmaparyāya</s> to beings. Even to beings reborn in the hells, in animal wombs, in <s>Yama</s>'s world, or in unfavorable states, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>, teaching this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Dharmaparyāya</s>, becomes their savior. Even to beings within the inner chambers [of palaces], the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>, manifesting a female form, teaches this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Dharmaparyāya</s> to beings. He teaches the <s>Dharma</s> to beings in this <s>Sahā</s> world-system. The <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> is indeed a savior, O <s>Padmaśrī</s>, of beings born in the <s>Sahā</s> world-system. And in this very <s>Sahā</s> world-system, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> teaches this <s>Saddharmapuṇḍarīka Dharmaparyāya</s> to beings through so many forms and appearances. Yet there is no diminishment of that noble being's supernatural power, nor diminishment of his wisdom. With so many illuminations of knowledge, son of good family, does the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> become known in this <s>Sahā</s> world-system. And in other world-systems, as numerous as the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, to beings amenable to the training of a <s>Bodhisattva</s>, he teaches the <s>Dharma</s> in the form of a <s>Bodhisattva</s>. To beings amenable to the training of a <s>Śrāvaka</s>, he teaches the <s>Dharma</s> in the form of a <s>Śrāvaka</s>. To beings amenable to the training of a <s>Pratyekabuddha</s>, he teaches the <s>Dharma</s> in the form of a <s>Pratyekabuddha</s>. To beings amenable to the training of a <s>Tathāgata</s>, he teaches the <s>Dharma</s> in the form of a <s>Tathāgata</s>. Even to those amenable to the sight of <s>Tathāgata</s>-relics, he shows <s>Tathāgata</s>-relics. Even to those amenable to [seeing the <s>Tathāgata</s>] passed into <s>parinirvāṇa</s>, he shows himself as having passed into <s>parinirvāṇa</s>. Such is the attainment of the power of knowledge, O <s>Padmaśrī</s>, of the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s>.

body.text: atha khalu padmaśrīrbodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavantametadavocat - avaropitakuśalamūlo 'yaṃ bhagavan gadgadasvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ | katama eṣa bhagavan samādhiryasmin samādhāvavasthitena gadgadasvareṇa bodhisattvena mahāsattvena iyantaḥ sattvā vinītā iti? evamukte bhagavān śākyamunistathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ padmaśriyaṃ bodhisattvaṃ mahāsattvametadavocat - eṣa hi kulaputra sarvarūpasaṃdarśano nāma samādhiḥ | asmin samādhāvavasthitena gadgadasvareṇa bodhisattvena mahāsattvena evamaprameyaḥ sattvārthaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Padmaśrī</s> (Lotus-Glory) said this to the Blessed One: 'This <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> has deeply planted roots of merit, O Blessed One. In what <s>samādhi</s> was the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> established when he disciplined so many beings?' When this was said, the Blessed One <s>Śākyamuni</s>, <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One, said this to the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Padmaśrī</s>: 'It is, O son of good family, the <s>samādhi</s> named <s>Sarvarūpasaṃdarśana</s> (Displaying All Forms). Established in this <s>samādhi</s>, the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> performed such immeasurable benefit for beings.'

body.text: asmin khalu punargadgadasvaraparivarte nirdiśyamāne yāni gadgadasvareṇa bodhisattvena mahāsattvena sārdhaṃ caturaśītibodhisattvakoṭīnayutaśatasahasrāṇi imāṃ sahāṃ lokadhātumāgatāni, sarveṣāṃ teṣāṃ sarvarūpasaṃdarśanasya samādheḥ pratilambho 'bhūt | asyāṃ ca sahāyāṃ lokadhātau
body.translated_text: Now, while this <s>Gadgadasvara</s> chapter was being taught, all those eighty-four <s>koṭis</s> of <s>nayutas</s> of hundreds of thousands of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> who had come to this <s>Sahā</s> world-system together with the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva</s> <s>Gadgadasvara</s> attained the <s>Sarvarūpasaṃdarśana Samādhi</s>. And in this <s>Sahā</s> world-system,

body.text: gaṇanāsamatikrāntānāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ yeṣāṃ sarvarūpasaṃdarśanasya samādheḥ pratilambho 'bhūt ||
body.translated_text: <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattvas</s> beyond all counting attained the <s>Sarvarūpasaṃdarśana Samādhi</s>.
